source_locator: R2225: ch. XII, Reduction of the Gifu
current_activity: completing the relief of the 132nd Infantry on the Gifu line
notes: Miller, ch. XII: the 35th Infantry had marched to Mount Austen on 8 January 1943, with 2nd Battalion moving into line at the Gifu. On 9 January the 2nd Battalion and the Cavalry Reconnaissance Troop completed the relief of the 132nd Infantry. By nightfall 2nd Battalion held the line from Hill 31 to Hill 27, a front of over 2,000 yards. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.

location_qualifier: approaching Hills 43 and 44 from the south
source_locator: R2225: ch. XII, Taking of the Sea Horse
current_activity: beginning the 3rd Battalion envelopment of the Sea Horse
notes: Miller, ch. XII: at 0635 on 10 January 1943, while the 27th Infantry attacked the Galloping Horse, 3rd Battalion, 35th Infantry, began its southern envelopment toward Hills 43 and 44 (the Sea Horse). There was no preliminary artillery or air bombardment in this zone, to preserve surprise. The battalion pushed south-west, turned north too soon, and by dusk had dug in on high ground 400 yards south of Hill 43. 2nd Battalion remained at the Gifu. The claim locates the regiment by the 3rd Battalion's main effort. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.

source_locator: R2225: ch. XII, Taking of the Sea Horse
current_activity: driving the Japanese off Hill 43 and occupying Hill 44
notes: Miller, ch. XII: 3rd Battalion, 35th Infantry, resumed the attack at dawn on 11 January 1943, drove the enemy off Hill 43, and by 1831 had advanced to Hill 44. By nightfall the regiment had completed the encirclement of the Gifu on the east and west by seizing the Sea Horse. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.

source_locator: R2225: ch. XII; R2227: Part VI, ch. 9
current_activity: clearing the last resistance out of the Gifu by nightfall
notes: The 35th Infantry cleared the last resistance out of the Gifu by nightfall on 23 January 1943 (Miller, ch. XII). Hough, Ludwig and Shaw, Part VI, ch. 9, independently record that the Gifu pocket was not completely reduced until 23 January. Old confidence was 0.5, from Miller only. New confidence is 0.7, because a second official family (usmc_history) agrees on the date.
